description: Unit test class for the LocaleUtility utility in the OpenMRS project, specifically testing locale operations like compatibility, default locale retrieval, and locale ordering.

classes.name: LocaleUtilityTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the behavior of LocaleUtility functions within the OpenMRS project.

methods.name: areCompatible_shouldConfirmMatchingLanguageAsCompatible
methods.description: Tests if LocaleUtility correctly identifies locales with the same language as compatible.

methods.name: areCompatible_shouldNotConfirmDifferentLanguageAsCompatible
methods.description: Tests if LocaleUtility correctly identifies locales with different languages as not compatible.

methods.name: areCompatible_shouldConfirmMatchingCountryAsCompatible
methods.description: Tests if locales with the same country are recognized as compatible.

methods.name: areCompatible_shouldNotConfirmDifferentCountryAsCompatible
methods.description: Tests if locales with different countries are recognized as incompatible.

methods.name: areCompatible_shouldConfirmSameLanguageMissingCountryAsCompatible
methods.description: Verifies compatibility when one locale has no country but same language.

methods.name: areCompatible_shouldConfirmDifferentLanguageMissingCountryAsCompatible
methods.description: Verifies non-compatibility when language differs and one locale is missing country.

methods.name: getDefaultLocale_shouldNotFailWithBogusGlobalPropertyValue
methods.description: Checks default locale retrieval when global property values are invalid or malformed.

methods.name: getDefaultLocale_shouldNotFailWithEmptyGlobalPropertyValue
methods.description: Ensures fallback to a non-null locale when global property is empty.

methods.name: getDefaultLocale_shouldNotReturnNullIfGlobalPropertyDoesNotExist
methods.description: Checks behavior when the default locale global property is absent.

methods.name: getDefaultLocale_shouldReturnLocaleObjectForGlobalProperty
methods.description: Verifies that the default locale is correctly derived from a global property.

methods.name: fromSpecification_shouldGetLocaleFromTwoCharacterLanguageCode
methods.description: Tests parsing of a simple language code into a Locale object.

methods.name: fromSpecification_shouldGetLocaleFromLanguageCodeAndCountryCode
methods.description: Tests parsing of locale from language and country codes.

methods.name: fromSpecification_shouldGetLocaleFromBCP47Format
methods.description: Tests parsing of BCP-47 formatted locale strings.

methods.name: fromSpecification_shouldReturnNullWhenLocaleFormatIsIncorrectLocaleFromBCP47Format
methods.description: Verifies that malformed locale specifications return null.

methods.name: fromSpecification_shouldGetLocaleFromLanguageCodeCountryCodeAndVariant
methods.description: Tests parsing of locale with language, country, and variant.

methods.name: getLocalesInOrder_shouldAlwaysHaveEnglishIncludedInTheReturnedCollection
methods.description: Validates inclusion of English locale in ordered set.

methods.name: getLocalesInOrder_shouldAlwaysHaveDefaultLocaleDefaultValueIncludedInTheReturnedCollection
methods.description: Ensures default locale is included in the list.

methods.name: getLocalesInOrder_shouldHaveDefaultLocaleAsTheFirstElementIfUserHasNoPreferredLocale
methods.description: Checks order when user has no preferred locale.

methods.name: getLocalesInOrder_shouldHaveDefaultLocaleAsTheSecondElementIfUserHasAPreferredLocale
methods.description: Checks order when user has a preferred locale.

methods.name: getLocalesInOrder_shouldReturnASetOfLocalesWithAPredictableOrder
methods.description: Verifies ordering of locales in the returned set based on global properties.

methods.name: getLocalesInOrder_shouldReturnASetOfLocalesWithNoDuplicates
methods.description: Ensures locale list contains no duplicates despite duplicate entries in global properties.

methods.name: should_resetTheLocale
methods.description: Resets the current user locale and clears locale caches. Always the last test method.

methods.name: getDefaultLocale_shouldNotCacheLocaleWhenSessionIsNotOpen
methods.description: Ensures that default locale retrieval does not rely on cached values when session is closed.
